# gsm_environment_config (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_environment_config" "example" {
  environment_id = "<environment_id>"
  config_name    = "app-config"

  config = {
    log_level   = "debug"
    feature_x   = "enabled"
    max_workers = "10"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Map of String) Configuration key-value pairs
- `config_name` (String) Name of the config
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID where the config belongs

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
